svg.text: Q20 resting buy limits on rising trendlines, 11 May - 15 May 2026

Rising lines through consecutive higher swing lows (5 bars each side, >= 10 bars apart, >= 0.02 x ATR per bar, one week), intact and departed by 1 x ATR. At each bar open the buy limit sits on the nearest such line below price;
it is fixed for that bar and re-priced at the next open. Stop = limit - 0.5 x ATR(14). Classify-only run: no orders, no outcomes.
